_note: Synthetic corpus for the alea-intake -> folio-resolve migration. Contains NO customer intake data: every narrative is invented, and the mini-ontology below is a hand-written stand-in for FOLIO (real IRIs are replaced with r-* stubs) so the harness runs offline, with zero LLM spend and no ontology download.

narratives.text: I was fired from my job last month
my landlord started an eviction after I complained
we are fighting about custody of our daughter
a collector keeps calling me about a debt I already paid
I slipped on ice in the parking lot and hurt my back
I was laid off with no notice
breach of warranty of habitability in a rental unit
FDCPA violation by a collection agency
My landlord refused to fix the heat all winter, then when I complained to the city he served me with an eviction notice and kept my deposit

_expect_legend: score_pairs.expect / fit.expect_reject state what the MIGRATION should do to each row. 'up' = the library scorer must score higher (a recall blindness the hand-rolled scorer had), 'down' = lower (the library's specificity penalty), 'same' = must not move at all, 'any' = either direction is acceptable. compare.py turns these into intended_fix / regression / neutral classifications.
